annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/610 of 14 April 2021 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/437 as regards harmonised standards on medical vehicles and their equipment, anaesthetic and respiratory equipment, biological evaluation of medical devices, and other medical device standards
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/610 of 14 April 2021 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/437 as regards harmonised standards on medical vehicles and their equipment, anaesthetic and respiratory equipment, biological evaluation of medical devices, and other medical device standards
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 129/153
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision amending Decision 2020/437 to update the list of harmonised standards for medical devices under Directive 93/42/EEC, replacing revised references and adding four new ones. It confers presumption of conformity. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Annex I of Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/437 by replacing references to revised harmonised standards.
Adds entries 265-268 (tracheal tubes, hearing aids, home light therapy, respiratory gas monitors).
Compliance with listed standards confers presumption of conformity with Directive 93/42/EEC.
Enters into force on the day of publication in the Official Journal.
